_comment: Hand-built, not recorded from a real `npx skills remove` run - unit 5.4 owns recording the real trace and replacing this file. Shape: `npx skills remove <name> --yes --global`, matching `remove_cli_args_and_cwd`'s SkillsSh/global branch (apps/cli's `remove --deployment-id ...` over a global skills.sh deployment). `files` names every file that existed under `.agents/skills/<skill>` before the run, relative to that folder - the tree the CLI deletes. `claude_code_link` is the pre-existing `.claude/skills/<skill>` link the CLI also removes, since a real `npx skills remove` with no `--agent` given acts on every detected agent, not just skills.sh's own tree (skills CLI v1.5.23 `dist/cli.mjs:6217-6263`; round 2, N1/B1). `lock_before` is the full `.agents/.skill-lock.json` document before the run; `lock_entry_removed` names the entry the CLI drops from it as part of the same call - the parity test diffs `lock_before` minus that entry against the lock file the fake CLI actually leaves, byte for byte apart from timestamps (`docs/action-map/definition-of-done.md` check 4).
